website_proxy_release_note: Use base_url for external scripts, notebooks, and third-party browser apps. The website_proxy_url is reserved for same-origin SurgeFlow pages and may not send third-party CORS headers.

authentication.note: Use query parameters only for quick tests; headers avoid leaking keys into logs and URLs.

rate_limit_store.note: Free and internal quotas use memory fallback for availability. Partner quotas require the distributed control bucket and fail closed if it is unavailable.

membership_record.note: The public beta is free and does not require paid membership setup.

open_endpoints.description: Stable endpoint catalogue, plans, limits, and schemas.
Self-serve free beta API key. Requires email and terms agreement; name optional.

authenticated_endpoints.description: Inspect the active API key — plan, scopes, and rolling usage (used_7d/used_30d) — without exposing its secret.
Four-market market-watch summary, freshness metadata, and FX context.
Paged institutional market screen for us/cn/jp/hk.

AI analyst panel scoreboard for the US hotlist: per-ticker composite scores, per-analyst scores and comments, paper long/short flags, tenure, and stop states. Research documentation, not investment advice.

The sole deterministic paper book: strict score >70 LONG and <30 SHORT positions with side-aware entry, stop, take-profit, outcomes, and daily six-area rationale gate decisions. Research documentation, not investment advice.
Latest ML clustering run: cluster profiles, sector mix, representative tickers, anomaly watch, and stability diagnostics. Descriptive analytics, not prediction.
Institutional-holdings signal board: consensus, conviction, crowdedness, position deltas, and network reads from disclosure filings.
Compact sector snapshot: per-ticker daily change with market-cap-weighted sector and industry means plus whale overlay.
Latest scored news articles with sentiment, tickers, and keywords. Query: ticker, sentiment, limit (max 50).
Canonical ERP-to-LIQ pure-factor portfolios: signed holdings weights, expected-shortfall statistics, aligned correlations, and return series; gate state is disclosed rather than used as a row filter.
The complete daily research notes: per-market sections plus the global note. Query: market (default all), as_of_date.
Per-market macro release calendar with consensus, actuals, and surprises. Query: market, days (max 60).
Bond ETF board: AUM, expense, last close, and 1y/YTD returns for the credit and rates complex.

response_shapes.ai_ratings: the scoreboard is returned at payload.data.names
response_shapes.ai_grade_book: positions at payload.data.rows, opener decisions at payload.data.decisions
response_shapes.ml_clusters: clusters at payload.data.clusters, anomalies at payload.data.anomaly_watch

spreadsheet_addin_namespace.purpose: Google Sheets add-on only. It is separate from the key-gated public API.

endpoints.description: Spreadsheet-safe realtime turnover board. Query: market, limit.

admin_endpoints.description: Generate a new hashed API key. Requires X-SurgeFlow-Admin-Token.
List key metadata without secrets. Requires X-SurgeFlow-Admin-Token.
List latest self-serve member records. Requires X-SurgeFlow-Admin-Token.
Revoke an API key. Requires X-SurgeFlow-Admin-Token.
